summary: Irenic Acquisition Corp., a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering of 22,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit for $220M gross proceeds, with an underwriter over-allotment option for up to 3.3M additional units. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one-third of a warrant. Related agreements executed include underwriting, warrant, letter, trust, registration rights, and sponsor private placement. The filing marks the IPO closing and trust funding, initiating the SPAC's search for a target within 24 months. Watch for future business combination announcements and de-SPAC risks.
